discovery.selector: Canonical *.flow.json corpus beneath flows, reconciled with authoritative artifacts entries with type exactly flow. Every declared path must resolve; valid unregistered source records remain visible with registration status kept separately.
discovery.identity: Exact source id, required nonempty string matching ^[a-z0-9-]+/[a-z0-9-]+$; equal to manifest id. Kind-scoped graph identity is Flow:<source id>.
discovery.record_shape: One Flow per registered JSON object. Flow steps and branches are owner-relative members, not independent top-level records.
discovery.title: Source name
discovery.description: Source summary, not abbreviated manifest summary
discovery.source_path: Repository-relative resolved canonical JSON path; locator is empty for the whole-file source record.
path_safety: Resolve each declared path beneath docs/product-truth/flows and verify the resolved path stays there and within the repository, including symlinks.

Reject absolute paths, drive paths, UNC paths, empty paths and parent traversal; require a .flow.json file. Normalize separators for path resolution only; preserve the literal manifest spelling in its metadata.
Reject duplicate manifest identities, duplicate resolved source paths, identity mismatches, malformed JSON and missing declared sources rather than silently omitting records.

Absent product-truth source directory and absent manifest mean an uninstalled surface and no Flow records. An existing malformed manifest or invalid artifacts collection is an explicit error; source records without registration must not silently disappear.

Do not enumerate HTML/Markdown mirrors or generated by_flow/by_component/by_entity/by_ac indexes as records. Expose a valid unregistered canonical JSON record while reporting its unregistered status in derived context; do not fabricate a manifest entry or mutate the authoritative manifest.

source_fields.component: string; authored singular owner spelling, not silently rewritten to a registry identifier
source_fields.product: optional string; display name, not ownership authority
source_fields.example_product: optional string slug; explicit example marker; absence must remain absence
source_fields.name: string
source_fields.kind: enum user|data|architecture; source kind must not replace Neo4j Flow type bookkeeping
source_fields.realization: optional enum built|spec|mock; do not materialize built when absent
source_fields.shape_version: optional integer >=1; absence has distinct legacy semantics
source_fields.steps: nonempty ordered array of step objects
source_fields.branches: optional ordered array of branch objects, including empty arrays
source_fields.impl_summary: optional object containing stored derived rollup; retain exactly without recomputation
source_fields.acceptance_scenarios: optional ordered array of scenario objects
source_fields.provenance: optional ordered array of provenance objects
source_fields.behind: optional stored derived object; presence itself is the behind mark
source_fields.confirmed: optional authored confirmation object; do not synthesize

fields.id: string; shared owner-local namespace with branch ids
fields.label: string
fields.order: integer; retain this independently from physical array order
fields.agent: optional string agent id or script/workflow actor name
fields.produces: optional string array of downstream named artifacts/fields
fields.consumes: optional string array of upstream named artifacts/fields
fields.implements: optional string array of authored AC ids
fields.expands_to: optional <product>/<name> string OR nonempty array of such strings; preserve either source shape exactly
fields.impl_asof: optional stored derived string timestamp/date; retain its source string type

fields.id: string; shared owner-local namespace with step ids
fields.label: string
fields.implements: optional string array of AC ids
fields.outcome_kind: optional enum alternative|failure|exit; absence must not be filled

fields.confirmed_against: nonempty string copied from confirmation identity
fields.changed: nonempty string array of changed described things

fields.state: map of arbitrary described-thing ids to string signatures; preserve every key verbatim, including slash/tilde characters

manifest_contract.handling: Preserve the complete manifest entry in a separate derived/auxiliary namespace, with manifest source path and /artifacts/<index> locator. Never overlay any manifest field on the canonical JSON record. This includes registration-only type/title/path and shorter summaries.
manifest_contract.mirrored_checks: Existing validator requires matching status, readiness and version; identity and safe declared path are essential ingestion checks. Other manifest fields can differ without replacing source values.
manifest_contract.container_note: Root manifest version/description/search_dimensions/entity_registry govern the store, not individual authored Flow fields. Do not inject them as ordinary Flow properties.

authority_and_projection.metadata: A deep copy of the entire source JSON mapping. Preserve every current or future source field rather than using an allowlist. Schema descriptions inform validation and display; never inject schema defaults.
authority_and_projection.derived_policy: Stored derived values are part of the pinned source and remain queryable in metadata. Identify their derivation separately; do not discard, recompute or relabel them as human assertions. confirmed is authored while behind is derived.
authority_and_projection.nested_projection: Use the shared native-property encoder to expose scalar leaves by escaped JSON-pointer paths while retaining array indices, object ownership, primitive types and source array shape. Retain explicit null and empty markers; do not make a separate competing FlowNode kind.
authority_and_projection.relationships: component, screen, mock_data_ref, implements, expands_to and scenario for/from are declared references. Retain them exactly regardless of optional relationship enrichment. Never infer components from actor names or swap hyphenated component spelling for a snake_case registry id without an explicit resolution contract.
authority_and_projection.normalization_hazard: generate_product_truth.load_flows() calls normalise_flow_shapes() in place and converts old expands_to strings to arrays. A native reader must read raw source JSON directly. Running generation/validation commands can also rewrite stored derived values and is outside read-only extraction.

required_verification: A schema-complete fixture including shape_version, confirmed with escaped keys, behind, nested steps/branches/scenarios/provenance, and stored rollups survives extraction exactly.
Old string and new array expands_to shapes both survive without normalization; physical step order and authored order integers are independently preserved.
Full source summary/tags and differing manifest summary/tags remain separately queryable; manifest title/path cannot overwrite source name/identity/provenance.
Absent optional fields, explicit superseded_by null, and empty branches/provenance/tags retain distinct shapes.

Canonical source discovery excludes mirrors, reconciles every registration, and exposes valid unregistered Flow JSON with separately recorded registration status. All 14 real source mappings compare deeply equal to extracted metadata.
Unsafe paths, duplicate identities/paths, malformed source, missing declared source and manifest/source id mismatch fail visibly.
Input JSON files are never rewritten and existing generator normalization is never invoked.
